'''Noldan''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived in [[Aurilia]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a master of melee combat and was known to train outsiders who were working for the good of Aurilia. He was secretly in love with [[Marite]], although, unknown to him, she knew this and reciprocated his feelings, but refused to act upon them until Aurilia was safe (it was under attack from the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]] and his [[Sith Shadows]]). It is unknown if they pursued a relationship after Mellichae was defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
Noldan featured in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', but was removed as part the New Game Enhancements of 2005, along with Aurilia.
